stories.title: Connelly breaks down a loaded Week 7: Notre Dame-BYU, Ohio State-Indiana and more
stories.summary: The Irish face their first test in the biggest college football game at Provo in ages, but that's just the tip of the iceberg.

stories.title: Sources: Eagles QB Hurts out indefinitely with blood clot, no IR planned
stories.summary: The Eagles are not planning to put Jalen Hurts on injured reserve, sources told ESPN, even as he remains sidelined indefinitely due to a superficial blood clot.

stories.title: LeBron fires up sellout Philly crowd with monster slam in home debut
stories.summary: LeBron James gave a sellout crowd a glimpse of his "connection" with new teammate Tyrese Maxey when James threw down an alley-oop jam in his Sixers home debut.

stories.title: Embiid adamant no one will 'take a back seat' on star-laden Sixers
stories.summary: Without VJ Edgecombe, who was held out of Friday night's 125-120 loss to the Celtics, 76ers coach Nick Nurse gave the closest glimpse of what this team may look like this season, including LeBron James and Joel Embiid playing preseason highs in minutes.

stories.title: ESPN secures 'handshake agreement' to broadcast 24-team CFP, sources say
stories.summary: The CFP reached a "handshake agreement" with ESPN to broadcast a 24-team playoff beginning in the 2027 season, sources told ESPN on Friday, and though there is work to be done on paper, this is a significant step closer to doubling the postseason field.
